TYPE 1 - NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED REZONING
AT
1347 WEST GRAND AVENUE

The Application is to change zoning for 1347 West Grand Avenue from B!-3 Neighborhood Shopping
District to B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. This zoning change is for purposes to allow Applicant to construct
a four-story, six dwelling unit building with a basement. There will be a six-car garage at the rear of the property. The
footprint of the building shall approximately be 29 feet by 134 feet in size. The building height shall be 46 feet 4
inches high, as defined by code.

Applicant will seek relief as per Section 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and/or Variation
to allow:

1. Under 17-13-1101-B to allow reduction of the Rear Yard from 30 feet to 3 feet, 9 inches;

2. Under 17-13-1003-EE to seek relief to allow six (6) off-street parking spaces (garage) even though the
Building is located within 2,640 of the CTA Blue Line;

3. Under 17-13-1101-A to seek relief from 17-13-1001-B Pedestrian Street Rules to allow the Building

location and construction of balconies in the front yard.
LOT AREA: 4,950 SQUARE FEET
FLOOR AREA RATIO: 2.68

BUILDING AREA: 13,260 SQUARE FEET

DENSITY, per DWELLING UNIT: 825.00 SQUARE FEET PER DWELLING UNIT

** OFF-STREET PARKING: SIX (6) GARAGE PARKING SPACES ARE PROVIDED, ACCESSED
THROUGH THE PUBLIC ALLEY.

** FRONT SETBACK: ONE (1) FOOT

REAR SETBACK: 3 FEET 9 INCHES
SIDE SETBACK: 1 FOOT (EAST) 3 FEET (WEST)

BUILDING HEIGHT: 46 FEET 4 INCHES

17-3-0307 EXCEPTIONS:
The applicant will comply with Section 17-3-0307 Exceptions of the Chicago Air Quality Ordinance should such

provision be determined as applicable.
*e (Applicant is seeking relief as a Variation through the Type 1 filing)

17-3-0308 SPECIFIC CRITERIA FOR TRANSIT-SERVED LOCATIONS
In Band C districts, any new construction within 2,640 feet of a CTA or Metra rail station entrance or exit must satisfy

all of the following specific criteria:

1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B;

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets,
even if the project is not located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street;

© The Building location is one (1) foot from the north property line;
e The proposed Building meets 17-3-0504-C Transparency requirements;

1

e The entry door faces the Street;

© Subsection E is not applicable (all Residential Building);

° Under Subparagraph F, parking will be enclosed and at the rear of the Property;
¢ Under Subparagraph G, parking access is from the Alley;

Under Subparagraph H-Not Applicable
The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station

Area Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan

Commission;
e The Project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide. It

is located in a Local Activity Center Area as an in-fill development and both on a qualified CTA

Bus route (#65) and 2450 feet to the Blue Line entrance at Chicago and Milwaukee Avenues;

The Project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago

Department of Transportation.
Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as an
administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

¢ — Six (6) off-street parking spaces are requested even though the Property is 2450 feet from the CTA

Blue Line entrance.
The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department

of Transportation. The City's Commissioner of Transportation is authorized to issue Travel Demand Study
and Management Plan rules consistent with this section.
e Not applicable.
